title: EprProjectionView
description: Notarized contract: this doorway projects this EPR at this URL path under these terms. Source of truth: rea_commitments where action='project-epr' (Notarized, Category A — backed by REA Commitment entry type on the DHT; this table is a read-optimized projection). Created via REA Commitment with action='project-epr'.

commitmentId.description: sha256(provider_peer_id|action|scope) — stable identity for this projection commitment.

eprId.description: Content row id of the projected EPR.

doorwayId.description: Doorway identifier for the projecting node (prefixed 'doorway:').

urlPath.description: Absolute URL path at which this EPR is projected on the doorway.

mode.description: Projection mode: cached = doorway caches and serves bytes; stewardDirect = doorway proxies to the steward node.

reach.description: Reach scope for this projection (e.g. commons, qahal:xxx, household:xxx).

baseHref.description: Base href used when serving this EPR's assets.

entryFile.description: Entry point file within the EPR bundle. Defaults to index.html.

redirectsFrom.description: Legacy URL paths that redirect to urlPath.

previewEprRef.description: CIDv1 base32 of the preview EPR, if this projection has a distinct preview variant. Null when no preview is configured.

gateHints.description: Ordered list of gate hints that callers should present or resolve before accessing this projection.

deadEnd.description: True when this projection is intentionally terminal — no outbound gate hints should be followed after arriving here.

spaFallback.description: Serve the projection's entry file for extension-less deep routes (SPA fallback). Defaults true for bundle EPRs.

stewardDirectEndpoint.description: Present only when mode=stewardDirect. Describes the steward node the doorway proxies to. Null when mode=cached.

seededAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this projection commitment was seeded onto the DHT.

seededBy.description: Steward peer_id that created this projection commitment.

eprRef.description: CIDv1 base32 of the EPR this gate hint points to.

label.description: Human-readable label for this gate hint. Null when not provided.

relation.description: Semantic relation type classifying what role the referenced EPR plays as a gate.

peerId.description: Peer ID of the steward node accepting direct proxy connections.

altHost.description: Alternate hostname for the steward endpoint. Null when not configured.

tlsCertSan.description: TLS certificate Subject Alternative Name expected from the steward node.

acceptsProjectionFor.description: EPR IDs this steward endpoint accepts projection responsibility for.
